Real excerpt of martj42/international_results (CC0-1.0) at commit b0948cb558c927c357db4067eac5b37b96d0e4bb: every match since 1990 involving England, France, Brazil, Argentina, Germany or Spain, plus four matches used by label tests (Croatia-Portugal 2016-06-25, Timor-Leste-Mongolia 2015-03-12, Morocco-Senegal 2026-01-18, United States-Panama 2023-07-12). Rows are byte-for-byte lines of the original files; nothing is invented.
